learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to guess how heavy objects are and how much water different containers can hold!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Some things are hard to lift, like a big watermelon, because they are heavy. Some things are easy to lift, like a feather, because they are light!
A big bucket can hold many jugs of water. A small glass can only hold a little bit. We call this capacity!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Water Bottle Magic
fun_activity.instructions: Take a big water bottle and a small cup. Guess how many cups of water it will take to fill the big bottle, then test it out!

quick_recap: ⭐ We can compare objects to see which one is heavier or lighter.
⭐ Bigger containers usually hold more liquid than smaller containers.
